databaseOutage.heading: Database unavailable
databaseOutage.retrying: Arc can’t reach its database. It will try again automatically.

database.heading: Choose a database
database.description: This is where Arc saves your libraries, profiles and watch history. The choice applies to this installation.
database.sqliteDescription: Recommended for most servers. Arc stores a database in its data folder.
database.postgresDescription: Advanced. Use a dedicated empty PostgreSQL database on your network.
database.startTimeout: Arc is starting with the chosen database. Reload this page to continue.

invite.description: You've been invited to watch on this Arc server. Choose a password; you'll sign in with your name and it from now on.
invite.heading: Invite link

profiles.enterPassword: Enter the password to use the admin profile
profiles.friend: Not part of this household? Sign in as a friend
profiles.heading: Who's watching?

setup.bypassDescription: On your home network, just pick a profile. Away from home the password is always needed, and your profile still asks for it (or its PIN) so others in the house can't change settings.
setup.description: First, set up your profile. It's the admin: it manages libraries and settings.
setup.heading: Welcome
setup.providersDescription: Arc uses them to recognise your movies and shows and fetch artwork, cast and episode details. You can add or change keys later in Settings, under Metadata providers.
setup.withoutKeys: Without keys, Arc still adds and plays your files, using their names and any artwork or .nfo files beside them. To look titles up later, add a key in Settings and refresh the library.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.serverPasswordDescription: Enter the server password to choose who’s watching.
signIn.friendOptionDescription: Sign in with your own name and password to watch what’s been shared with you.
signIn.inviteHelp: First time here? Open the invite link your host sent you.
